name: planner-basics
description: Five progressively harder planning-mode objectives. Each one is observable purely on the local filesystem (no network, no extra packages), so the suite is a fast, deterministic indicator of how well the planner decomposes a goal, carries verified facts forward, and proves completion through independent state checks. Tasks build from a single file up to a multi-file workspace that genuinely needs decomposition.

tasks.name: create-ready-file
tasks.objective: create the file /tmp/ada-bench-planner/ready and prove the file exists

tasks.name: capture-kernel-release
tasks.objective: write the kernel release (the output of 'uname -r') into /tmp/ada-bench-planner/kernel.txt and prove the file exists and is non-empty

tasks.name: config-with-mode
tasks.objective: create /tmp/ada-bench-planner/app/config.yaml containing the line 'mode: prod' with file mode 0644, and prove the file exists with that content and mode

tasks.name: two-file-workspace
tasks.objective: set up a workspace under /tmp/ada-bench-planner/ws containing a settings.ini file with the line 'enabled=true' and a VERSION file containing '1.0.0', and prove both files exist with the expected content

tasks.name: provision-app-tree
tasks.objective: provision a small application workspace at /tmp/ada-bench-planner/srv: create the directories conf and data, write conf/app.yaml containing 'name: ada-demo' and 'mode: prod', record the current user into data/owner.txt, and prove that both directories exist, the config contains both lines, and the owner file is non-empty
